$comment: Changes reach dev only through a squash-merged work PR whose 'pr-check / Work PR' check passed — its title becomes the one commit on dev. main is require-release-pr.json's. DISABLED by default: the Release workflow fast-forwards dev to the release commit with GITHUB_TOKEN, so the GitHub Actions app (Integration 15368) must be able to bypass it. Enable it per repo with .github/rulesets/require-pull-request.json containing {"enforcement": "active"}, run one release, and confirm it went through.
name: ci: require pull request
